newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Dec trade surplus falls to 125.4 mln Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Dec trade surplus falls to 125.4 mln Sfr.

text.p: Switzerland's trade surplus fell to 125.4 million Swiss francs in December from a revised 804.3 million surplus in November, the Federal Customs Office said.
The surplus for the full year was 1,696.8 million, compared with the 1,236.5 million surplus in 1995.
Note - Discrepancy due to rounding. Original Nov deficit 781.7 million francs, imports 7,689.5 million and exports 8,471.2 million.
The figures above were for Index Total 1, which excludes precious metals, percious stones, art objects and antiques.
The following figures comprise Total 2, or trade in all items:
Switzerland ran a 1996 surplus of 1,417.8 million francs in this category on exports of 98.08 billion and imports of 96.66 billion. -- Zurich newsroom +41 1 631 7340
